findings: Official Ollama gemma4:e4b supports vision, tools, audio, and thinking and runs correctly with explicit think=false/true.

Fine-tuned PEFT adapter import into Ollama reaches adapter conversion only after renaming adapter_model.safetensors to model.safetensors, then fails with unsupported architecture for Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration.

Manual split GGUF + mmproj import failed runtime validation earlier; text-only GGUF generated raw special-token output, indicating tokenizer/chat-template metadata mismatch with Ollama official gemma4.
Direct Safetensors import created an MLX-backed model but could not run on this Linux CUDA host because MLX runtime is unavailable.
Do not report fine-tuned Ollama performance until an Ollama-compatible Gemma4 adapter or merged multimodal export path is available.
